categories.main_business_segments: China Lesso Group Holdings Limited operates primarily in plastic piping systems, building materials and home improvement, environmental protection, new energy, and supply chain service platforms. The plastic piping systems segment is the core business, accounting for over 84% of total revenue, followed by building materials and home improvement, and other businesses including environmental protection and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes industry-leading technology and smart manufacturing, integrating AI, 5G, Internet, and IoT technologies with digital operations management to develop smart factories combining intelligent manufacturing and automated production. It focuses on green manufacturing and sustainable development, with ongoing R&D in high-performance plastic pipe processing, composite pipe manufacturing, and polymer composite materials. The Group also holds numerous patents and participates in national and industry standard setting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: China Lesso serves a broad range of customers including government departments, central and state-owned enterprises, infrastructure projects, real estate developers, and agricultural and aquaculture sectors. Its products are widely applied in home improvement, civil architecture, municipal water supply, drainage, energy management, electric power transmission, telecommunications, gas supply, fire services, environmental protection, agriculture, and marine aquaculture.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates over 30 production bases across 19 provinces in China and overseas countries including Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Cambodia, Vietnam, Africa, and the United States. It has a nationwide sales network in China with nearly 3,000 exclusive first-tier distributors and has established overseas sales centers in more than ten countries and regions, focusing on Southeast Asia, Africa, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Lesso operates primarily as an integrated manufacturer and supplier within the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing a comprehensive range of piping and building materials. It also operates downstream through extensive distribution networks and supply chain service platforms, including logistics and warehousing services, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic priorities include focusing on core piping business, smart manufacturing, innovation, global expansion, and sustainable development aligned with China's dual carbon strategy. R&D efforts focus on new product development, high-performance and diversified piping solutions including nuclear power and hydrogen transmission pipes, green manufacturing, and digital transformation of production processes. The Group also pursues product upgrades and technological breakthroughs to maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of goods related to plastic piping systems, building materials, and home improvement products. Additional income streams include contract revenue from renovation and installation works, environmental engineering services, logistics and supply chain services, financial services, and property rental. The Group also derives investment income from its associates and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Lesso is positioned as a leading large-scale industrial group in China's piping and building materials industry, recognized as a benchmark and leader in quality and innovation. It competes in a market facing challenges such as overcapacity and price competition but maintains a leading position through technological innovation, diversified product offerings, and strategic partnerships with government and state-owned enterprises. The Group also leverages its overseas expansion to strengthen its global market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB27.03 billion, a 12.4% decrease from 2023, with profit attributable to owners of RMB1.68 billion, down 28.9%. Total assets were RMB58.33 billion, and total equity was RMB24.42 billion. The Group maintains a healthy gearing ratio of 44.6% and positive cash flow with RMB6.64 billion in cash and bank deposits. Despite recent declines due to market conditions, the Group demonstrates resilience and a stable financial position with ongoing capital expenditure focused on automation and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Lesso emphasizes high-quality products, industry-leading technology, and customer satisfaction as its core values. Its comprehensive product portfolio with over 10,000 types of piping and building materials, combined with smart manufacturing and green production, differentiates it in the market. The Group’s focus on innovation, sustainable development, and global expansion enables it to provide efficient, environmentally friendly piping solutions and integrated services, supporting infrastructure and green transformation initiatives domestically and internationally.
